changes.title: Pause pending press
items: A button pressed just as you pause no longer closes the menu you're in

changes.title: Zoo inscriptions
items: Each zoo island's name, place and description is carved into the street just south of its fence, in faintly glowing, weathered letters, instead of a floating sign
An island you haven't found yet shows just its animal and biome

changes.title: Zoo polish
items: A little treehouse just north of the zoo's middle is the way out: walk up to it and press E (exit)
Flying or walking off the zoo's edge takes you out of it too, with a short fade
The zoo's middle shows the World Tree as an old carving in the flagstones: thin, worn grooves with a faint mint light in them
At the zoo's edge the water races out to a bright crest and pours off into space
